'''Laguna Aurorae''' is an island located in the [[Sunset Ocean]], requiring level 58 [[Sailing]] to moor at. The island is notable for containing the [[Kurask Lair]]. Laguna Aurorae is inhabited by multiple [[moss giant]]s, [[leech]]es, [[giant mosquito]]es, [[Pirate (Thieving)|pirates]], and [[giant toad]]s, and is currently the only location where [[mangrove]] trees are found. It contains one [[clue scroll (hard)|hard]]-tier [[Treasure Trails]] clue step location.

==Transportation==
* [[Mooring point]] (requires {{SCP|Sailing|58}})
** The mooring point is surrounded by aggressive [[pygmy kraken]]s, so it's safest to approach the mooring point fast and dock quickly.
** The nearest port with a [[shipwright]] to retrieve a boat and sail over is located on [[Aldarin]].
* [[Spirit tree]] (requires having moored at the island, but does not require talking to the tree first)

==Utilities and resources==
* [[Loom (amenity)|Loom]] (needs to be built first)
* [[Cooking pot (amenity)|Cooking pot]] (needs to be built first)
* [[Water pump (amenity)|Water pump]] (needs to be built first)
* Several [[fishing spots]] ([[fishing spot (lantern)|lantern harpooning]] on the southern shore, [[Fishing spot (big net, harpoon)|harpoon/big net]] next to spirit tree)
* A [[yew tree]]
* A [[Chest (Laguna Aurorae)|locked chest]] (unlocked with the [[serrated key]] to obtain the [[crystal glider's outfit]])
* A [[Small key (Laguna Aurorae)|small key]] can be dug up 4 tiles east of the western house door.
* 8 [[kurask]] found in the [[Kurask Lair]], next to the spirit tree

==Building the amenities==

== Trivia ==
* The island's name is Latin for "lake of the dawn".
* Although it was found on the map in the [[June 2025 Sailing Beta|Sailing beta]], the island was not accessible by players until the skill's full release.
